title: Hutan agent insight report, v1
description: What `hutan agent report --insight-json` accepts (docs/integrations.md § Report your agent's stats to Hutan). Every part is optional; a part the agent does not know is left out, never zero. Counts, tool names and relative paths only: no prompt, no tool output, no diff. At most 4096 bytes as JSON. Fields this schema does not list are ignored by Hutan, so a newer sender stays valid.

source.description: Who knows this. Default `extension`. `chat` is the daemon's own and is refused; `transcript` and `osc7501` are Hutan's own readers, listed because the daemon takes them.

turn.description: A turn of the agent (from the user's prompt to the agent being idle again) began or ended.

outcome.description: How an ending turn ended; absent means `completed`. A turn that ends is never `running` (the report is refused).

duration_ms.description: How long the turn took, when the agent measured it.

tokens.description: What ONE model call of the running turn used: a delta, not a running total. A counter the agent does not know stays out.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens. Send them without the cache counters when the agent can split them (the Anthropic shape); Hutan derives a cache hit ratio only for the agents it knows (omp, claude, codex).

cached_input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens read from the provider's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens written to the provider's cache.

context.description: The context window now (a level: the latest report wins).

window.description: The model's context window; 0 is ignored.

fixed.description: What the context holds before the first message (system prompt, tools, project files); with it the context splits into fixed and messages. Send it when the agent starts, switches conversation, compacts or changes model.

estimated.description: The agent's own estimate, not a count its provider gave. Default false.

cost_usd.description: The cost of the whole conversation so far in US dollars, by the agent's own price table (cumulative, not a delta). A value that is not a finite number of at least zero is dropped.

api_ms.description: Milliseconds the agent has spent waiting for its model so far (cumulative).

tools.description: Tools that finished since the last report, one row per name. At most 16 rows (the first ones are kept).

failed.description: Of them, calls that failed; default 0.

ms.description: Time the calls took together, when the agent says.

files.description: Files the agent changed since the last report (reads are not changes). At most 32 (the first ones are kept). Paths never go into notifications or user hooks.

path.description: Relative to the session's folder when inside it; at most 260 bytes (cut); a path with a control character is dropped.
